description: This file defines a static utility class 'Identifier' within the 'Orleans.CodeGenerator.SyntaxGeneration' namespace. It provides methods to check if a string is a C# keyword and to sanitize identifiers by removing invalid characters or prefixing digits.

classes.name: Identifier
classes.description: A static utility class for handling C# identifiers, including keyword checking and sanitization.

methods.name: IsCSharpKeyword
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a C# reserved keyword.

methods.name: SanitizeIdentifierName
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to make it a valid C# identifier by removing invalid characters and prefixing digits.
